note: Transition views use role:transition and transition_id. Views bind images; spatial_graph must cover spaces/transitions and bind atlas_digest. Human approval is required for atlas and spatial design separately; one actual user message may approve both. required_space_ids and required_transition_ids must equal the approved baseline spatial_scope. Large/continuous spaces require at least two baseline regions/segments, a distinct key_scene image and camera for each segment with its segment_id, and actual transition views. A single overview or repeated image cannot stand in for regional design expansion.
